div.div:
RECOMMENDED STARTING POINT:
learning_rate=5e-5, temperature=1.0, batch_size=4, num_train_steps=500,
max_seq_length=512, top_p=0.9, gradient_checkpointing=True, load_in_4bit=True
Then tune based on results!

div.b:
NON-TECHNICAL: Like adjusting settings on a camera - ISO (learning rate), aperture (temperature), shutter speed (batch size). Start with auto mode, then adjust!
TECHNICAL: Hyperparameters control convergence speed, diversity, stability. Start conservative, monitor metrics, adjust incrementally. Use grid search or Optuna for systematic tuning.
